column1: # Why it is wired this way (harbor#1278, operator decision 2026-11-11):
# member.tests runs on the operator's own box as well as on a member's. The Upgrade-line check (member.upgrade) stays member-only.
# One engine, two events: the snapshot at UserPromptSubmit, the check at Stop. box-tests.sh reads hook_event_name and runs
# member-tests.sh from beside it, so a member box keeps its own wiring (bin/member-managed.sh) and this one is the box's.
# It stands down the harbor checkout itself (harbor has its own gates) and, like admission-stop.sh, on stop_hook_active, so a turn is
# sent back at most once. Timeout 10: the check bounds itself (snap 5 s, stop 8 s) and fails open.
